tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and key actions on surface / surface-sunken. Pairs with `text` (dark), not white — 5.87:1. Too bright for white text (would be 2.5:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / active state for primary. Still pairs with `text` — 4.74:1. Recalculated for this hue; the old teal hover (#0B5D57) is too dark to use here.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Filled secondary buttons and chart lines for water-related data. White text passes AA at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / active state for secondary.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The blue half of the brand pair (green `primary` = the main action, blue `brand` = identity): Navbar background, links, outline buttons. White text on it is 4.95:1; as text it is 4.95:1 on `surface` and 4.66:1 on `surface-sunken`. Same hex as `secondary` today but kept as its own token so the two roles can diverge. Never use as text on `tint-sky` (4.16:1) — use `brand-hover` or `text`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / active state for `brand` (link hover, outline-button hover). White text 7.26:1; as text 6.84:1 on `surface-sunken` and 6.11:1 on `tint-sky`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Matched-scenario / high-confidence state. White text passes AA at 5.0:1. Pair with a check icon or label, not color alone. Distinct in lightness from the brighter `primary` — check the two don't sit adjacent unlabeled.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low-confidence / partial-match state. White text passes AA at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: No-match / error state. White text passes AA at 6.5:1. Pair with an icon or label — see README on success/danger.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Page background, the light theme's ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface / surface-sunken. 13.8:1 on surface-sunken (AAA). Also the required text color on `primary` and `primary-hover`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on surface / surface-sunken. 5.8:1 on surface-sunken (AA).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, input borders, card outlines. Non-text — no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: Light chip/badge background for variety or plant tags. Re-tinted to match the new yellow-green `primary` hue family. Pair only with text, never white.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Light chip/badge background and chart area fills for water-related data. Pair only with `text` or `brand-hover`, never white and never `brand` (4.16:1).

families.sans: "LINE Seed Sans TH", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped", "LINE Seed Sans TH", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. (LINE Seed Sans TH ships Regular/Bold only — no 600 weight.)

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and descriptions. Set in IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped (`--font-body`), not LINE Seed.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, form labels, timestamps. Set in IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped (`--font-body`), not LINE Seed.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps — icon-to-label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Spacing between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips/badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, large panels.
